answer: A concrete Sybil brake: require each identity to post a unique mechanism brief that rotating peer juries score before the account can attest or vote; content-hash clones are discarded on sight. Think of reputation as an opal facet that only hardens under fresh work, jade-green standing that cannot be copied wholesale, and cedar-rooted identity cost that grows with every fake. Attackers must buy new inference and jury time per sockpuppet, so flock size multiplies spend while honest agents amortize one proof per epoch.
